task_items: gcloud-storage-transfer.tf, Terraform file, /infra, opened with VSCode, contains google_storage_transfer_job resource with transfer_spec source_gcs_data_source and sink fields

gsutil -m rsync -r -d gs://source-bucket gs://destination-bucket, command, executed in terminal, synchronises all objects from the source GCS bucket to the destination deleting objects absent in the source
gsutil rewrite -s nearline gs://mybucket/**, command, executed in terminal, rewrites all objects in the bucket changing their storage class to Nearline without creating new objects
gsutil iam ch allUsers:objectViewer gs://public-bucket, command, executed in terminal, adds an IAM binding granting public object read access to the specified GCS bucket
gcloud storage buckets describe gs://mybucket, command, executed in terminal, retrieves bucket metadata including location, storage class, lifecycle rules, and IAM policy fields
object-lifecycle-policy.json, JSON file, /config, opened with VSCode, contains rule array entries with condition age and action fields for automated object transition and deletion
global_task_intention: Migrate and manage Google Cloud Storage buckets with lifecycle policies and IAM access controls

task_items: porter-app-preview.yaml, YAML file, /.porter, opened with VSCode, contains apps with web service build context, health check path, and environment group reference fields
porter apply -f porter-app.yaml, command, executed in terminal, reads the Porter application manifest and creates or updates services on the connected Kubernetes cluster
porter env groups create mygroup --name DATABASE_URL --value $PGURL, command, executed in terminal, creates an environment variable group in Porter accessible to linked application services
porter run web -- python manage.py migrate, command, executed in terminal, opens a one-off container in the Porter web service and executes the specified command
porter logs --deployment-id $ID, command, executed in terminal, streams log output from all pods in the specified Porter deployment to the terminal
porter preview create --name pr-$PR_NUMBER, command, executed in terminal, provisions an ephemeral preview environment linked to the pull request number for integration testing
global_task_intention: Deploy and manage ephemeral preview environments and production services on Kubernetes with Porter

virtctl ssh myvm -n mynamespace, command, executed in terminal, establishes an SSH tunnel through the KubeVirt API server to the virtual machine guest
datavolume-pvc.yaml, YAML file, /k8s, opened with VSCode, contains a DataVolume spec with source http url and pvc accessModes and storage request fields for VM disk provisioning
kubevirt-live-migration-policy.yaml, YAML file, /k8s, opened with VSCode, contains a MigrationPolicy spec with selectors namespaceSelector and virtualMachineInstanceSelector label match fields
